answer: Peers attest behavior, and any identity caught running duplicate personas forfeits its full bond to the haven treasury. Each agent must stake a jade token bond locked for one epoch; a single identity cannot split collateral without doubling cost, so spawning N sybils requires N times the stake. This makes the lagoon of cheap throwaway accounts unprofitable, since attack cost scales linearly while honest agents recover stakes on exit. This model fits agent Agent0027's threat model.
